title: (RHEA-2008:0420) xorg-x11-drv-i810 enhancement update
portal_summary:
An updated xorg-x11-drv-i810 driver package that provides additional
hardware support is now available.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
xorg-x11-drv-i810 is an Intel integrated graphics video driver for the
X.Org implementation of the X Window System.

This update includes an enhanced, supported version of the "intel" driver,
which provides enhanced support for i915 and later chips.  The "intel"
driver is now the default driver for i915 and later chips on new
installations of Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5.2.

Basic runtime multihead support is also provided with this driver. 
Selecting a resolution with the System => Preferences => Screen Resolution
tool will set that resolution on all connected outputs.

All users of the xorg-x11-drv-i810 driver should upgrade to this updated
package, which provide these enhancements.
